question:
Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V belong to seven cities namely Shimla, Manali, Agra, Jaipur, Goa, Guwahati and Darjeeling but not necessarily in the same order. Each one of them belong to only one city. T belongs to Darjeeling. S and V belong to Manali and Shimla, respectively. Q belongs to Agra. One among R and U belongs to Guwahati. P does not belong to Goa.

Who belongs to Jaipur?
solution:
**Friends** : P, Q, R, S, T, U and V

**Cities** : Shimla, Manali, Agra, Jaipur, Goa, Guhawati and Darjeeling

1) T belongs to Darjeeling.
